mcp_tools.name: rag_retrieval_evaluation_tuning
mcp_tools.title: Rag retrieval evaluation tuning
mcp_tools.description: Submit a retrieval-system evidence manifest (corpus and chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking and filters, index hygiene, evaluation, serving and privacy); get a deterministic RAG_EVALUATION_SOUND / RAG_EVALUATION_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed recall@k, MRR and nDCG against per-query declared thresholds and scope-leakage checks, with per-check evidence. Declared evidence only; no live index is queried.

inputSchema.description: The retrieval evaluation manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and the golden-query schema).

corpus_and_chunking.description: Corpus and chunking evidence (inventory, freshness, dedup, provenance, chunking discipline).

hybrid_retrieval.description: Hybrid retrieval evidence (lexical + vector, declared combination weights, pinned embedding model).

reranking_and_filters.description: Reranking and filter evidence (reranker budget, bounded top-N, context token budget).

index_hygiene.description: Index-hygiene evidence (incremental updates, tombstones, rebuild drill, versioning).

evaluation.description: Evaluation evidence: golden queries with declared relevance, retrieved lists and per-query thresholds; scope-leakage declarations.

serving_and_privacy.description: Serving and privacy evidence (latency budgets, caching, fallback, query-time scopes).

expect.notes: All booleans true, metrics meet thresholds. computed_spot_checks: mean_recall_at_k=1.0000, mean_mrr=1.0000, mean_ndcg_at_k=1.0000 [CORRECTED by tester: relevance_grades as object {doc: grade} per SERVICE.md "unlisted = 0" / atom metric shape; originally designed as a list.]

quality gate: embedding model + index versioned

no private corpus declared
